litematicainventories.title: Litematica Storages+
storage.coverage: Expected: %s known / %s ? · target: %s known / %s ? · stale %s · conflicts %s
storage.target_cache: Expected ×%s; target unscaled. Live: %s; remaining values are last observations; ≥ means partial.
storage.offline: Expected ×%s; target unavailable without a placement in a loaded world.
storage.status.no_placement: Storage preview: no matching enabled placement
storage.status.ambiguous: Storage preview: choose a placement in Litematica / F10
storage.status.sync: Storage preview: waiting for full menu synchronization
storage.status.unsupported: Unsupported container: recording and preview disabled
storage.serialization_error: Inventory serialization failed; previous snapshot retained. See log.
storages.track.drag: Drag and release to save position
storages.disabled: Storage accounting is disabled in F10
storages.clear.confirm: Remove all tracked storages? The schematic inventory cache will be kept.
storages.manager.empty: No tracked storages in this group
storages.label: Storage name (optional)
storages.groups.name: Group name
storages.groups.delete.confirm: Storages will become ungrouped. Saved contents will be kept.
storages.groups.bind: Bind counted group to this schematic
storages.nested.shift: Hold Shift for expected → actual contents
storages.groups.save_first: Load or save a schematic file to create a persistent binding
storages.locate.unavailable: Available for valid physical storages in the current dimension
storages.manager.count.help: Click to choose the counted group independently of the display filter. A schematic binding takes priority over the global choice.
storage.clear.confirm.title: Confirm data deletion
storage.clear.container.confirm: Clear the saved schematic observations for this container? Tracked resource storage data will be kept.
storage.clear.world.confirm: Clear the schematic inventory cache for the current world/server? Tracked resource storages will be kept.
storage.clear.all.confirm: Clear the schematic inventory cache for ALL worlds and servers? Tracked resource storages will be kept.
storage.cleanup.confirm: Delete schematic observations AND tracked storage entries older than %s hours in all worlds/servers? Entries with unknown observation time will be kept.
storage.placement.help: Select the next enabled Litematica placement for comparison when several schematics overlap.
storages.breakdown.help: Show inventory, ender chest and storage totals in item tooltips. This does not change resource counting.
storages.groups.drag: Hold the left mouse button and drag to a group heading to move this storage
storages.rename.help: Edit the tracked storage name in its title. Enter saves; Escape cancels the edit.
dashboard.info.title: Details
dashboard.info.storage: Select a storage to view its name, group, coordinates and saved contents. Drag it onto a group to change membership. Scroll here to read more.
dashboard.info.setting: Select a setting to read its description. Done saves preferences; Cancel or Escape restores preferences from when this window opened. Confirmed data deletions and storage organization changes are applied immediately. Reset restores the selected setting, or the current tab if none is selected.
dashboard.cancel.help: Undo preference changes and close. Confirmed data deletion and storage organization are not undone.
dashboard.accounting.help: Record and refresh resources in marked storages when they are opened. Turning this off preserves saved observations.
dashboard.sources.help: Include inventory and selected tracked storages in Material List and Info HUD. Off counts only the inventory. Groups and schematic bindings choose which storages contribute.
dashboard.icon.help: Show the transparent tracking icon in supported container title bars. Click to toggle tracking; hold and drag to move it.
dashboard.profile.help: Manual world profile for servers with several worlds at one address. Observations and resource counts are isolated by profile. Use a non-empty name, up to 100 characters.
dashboard.limit.help: Maximum saved schematic container observations: 1 to 200000. This does not change the separate tracked-storage ledger limit.
dashboard.color.help: Eight hexadecimal digits: AARRGGBB. AA controls opacity (00 transparent, FF opaque); RR, GG and BB are red, green and blue. Reset restores the selected color.
dashboard.ttl.help: Hours until a schematic observation is considered stale: 0 to 876000. Zero disables staleness. This does not automatically delete tracked storages or their resource counts.
dashboard.cleanup.help: Age threshold in hours for explicit cleanup: 1 to 876000. Delete older data asks for confirmation and affects all worlds/servers. Unknown observation dates are preserved.
dashboard.position.help: Restore default tracking-icon positions for supported container types. Cancel can restore your previous positions until Done is pressed.
dashboard.invalid: Some values are invalid. Correct them before saving.
dashboard.recording.help: Record synchronized container contents for saving into schematics. Turning this off does not stop the independent tracked-resource ledger.
dashboard.overlay.help: Show schematic contents and slot comparison colors in supported container menus. Does not change recording or resource counting.
